25 Olive Matthews - 70 - Cincinnati - operation yesterday ... E'd Dewitt - large family - behind with rent ... anxious Joyn Gramer - 52 - lost arm this a.m. - prayed for last week. Mrs. Este11 0'Brien - 31 - Stroke 2 week ago - now fears loss of sight.

Mrs. A. Madeline - 81 - poor circulation
